summary: Add coherent read-only arrangements to the st3 scenario roster, with Sidebar inventories for the refactor and scale worlds and an arrangements-absent discovery variant

replay.detail: Development and test scenario replay serves arrangement list, detail and collection snapshots from the same roster inventory; no deployed runtime replay change.

schema.detail: No database schema change; synthetic arrangements use the existing client-v0 Arrangement and ArrangementPage contracts.

compatibility.detail: Healthy scenarios advertise arrangements version 1 and person-scoped read.arrangements version 0 without control.arrangements. Synthetic UUIDv7 identities and rebased timestamps do not change the client protocol or deployed runtime compatibility.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; this change affects scenario fixtures and their consumers only.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
